items.title: MCP-lite smoke workflow
items.summary: Demonstrate the MCP-lite tool surface over a disposable Railyard workflow database.
done_definition: One System ticket is dispatched through MCP-lite.
The Runner claims the ticket and records a valid result.
The Architect reviews and accepts the result.
The ticket reaches status=finalised and next_actor=none.
notes: This queue is intended for disposable demo workspaces.
MCP-lite should not create or rewrite ticket Markdown.
Do not use raw SQL or write scratch files inside .workflow/.
